originalEntry.description: A 38-second pelican-on-a-bicycle film for which Opus wrote its own GPU ray-marching renderer; pier, sea, sky and music all come from code, 1140 frames.
originalEntry.description_zh: 38 秒「鹈鹕骑自行车」短片，Opus 自写 GPU 光线步进渲染器，栈桥、海面、天空和配乐全由代码生成。
originalEntry.prompt: 每次一个新的模型出来呢，大家都让它去画 “鹈鹕骑自行车” 来判断这个模型的空间能力，基本上都是用 HTML、SVG 来画动画。当我实在看得都有审美疲劳了，我希望你能画一个最复杂、最精细、最精美的 “鹈鹕骑自行车”的动画视频，你可以用任何的技术，不用着急，画一天都可以。
originalEntry.prompt_en: Every time a new model comes out, everyone asks it to draw a “pelican riding a bicycle” to judge its spatial ability, and it is basically always an animation drawn with HTML and SVG. I am honestly tired of seeing them, so I want you to draw the most complex, most detailed, most beautiful “pelican riding a bicycle” animation video. You can use any technique. No rush, you can spend a whole day drawing it.
